note: Studio Manager (Shorts) components for Daily Bible Pause devotionals. Built files: dist/ (rebuilt by build.mjs, git-ignored) or uploaded/ (exact uploaded bytes kept where the source no longer rebuilds them). Paste 'registration' as-is into a project's document.components[] (or a register-component operation). Register each code asset under ONE versionId per project (a second versionId for the same asset broke renders, 2026-10-08). Every item must set every control.

components.purpose: Dims (optionally grades) the picture under text. Own visual track above the clips.
Daily Bible Pause book mark and name at the top (top 230).
Word-by-word kinetic caption: hero phrase big serif caps, accents italic, rest Inter caps. wordTimes = each word's start (s) from the item start, comma separated, one per word of text. Latin only.
Typed text on torn paper strips; '|' starts a new strip. Latin only.
Russian Caption-orange (Cyrillic subsets, Russian function words).
Calm serif line under a thin gold hairline (Cyrillic + Latin).

The long form's reflection sentence as DevotionalVideo draws it (reflection-focus + WordReveal): Inter 400, line height 1.46, each word fades in as it is spoken, lands in accentColor and settles to color over 0.42 s; highlight (a phrase of the text, or "") keeps accentColor. LUMO / clean style: color #eae6df, accentColor #e6a35c; the graded style uses #ece9e4 / #f2c46b. 9:16: fontSize 58, width 760, align left (the vertical cut does not centre its reflection); top is the block's vertical centre (960, 1040 under a source mark, 1140 under a verse callout). wordTimes = each word's start (s) from the item start; empty spreads the words evenly. Latin only: no Cyrillic Inter build yet (RU still uses reveal-serif-ru-v2).

Book icon, title ('Historical Context') and 'SOURCE: …' top left. Latin only.
One PT Serif italic line (e.g. 'From Full Devotional'). Latin only.
Silent closing line over a dim. Renders small; native Inter 600 66 text reads better.
Jesus Film Project logo animation of the vertical teaser (the lockup is read from DevotionalVideo.tsx).

The 9:16 clip-first stepper (Stepper.tsx StepperLine): labels stacked with a thin rail; the rail draws down onto `step` (0-based), which lights gold, swells a little and comes into focus; passed steps stay gold, steps ahead dim and blurred. steps = comma list (EN "WATCH,REFLECT,PRAY", RU "ИСТОРИЯ,РАЗМЫШЛЕНИЕ,МОЛИТВА"; Inter 600 caps Latin + Cyrillic embedded). moveStartSec 0.25, moveSec 2.1, centerY 960, item ~2.8 s.

The verse the reflection is talking about (VerseCalloutOverlay.tsx): light Literata italic in curly quotes; `highlight` (one phrase of the text, at most 24 characters, or "") turns white with a gold rule drawn under it at litAtSec, then breathes. Shrinks from maxFontSize to fit maxHeight. 9:16: top 430 (owner moved it down from 300, 2026-10-16), width 860, maxHeight 420, maxFontSize 56; put the reflection sentence at top 1140 while it is up.
Russian build of verse-callout (Cyrillic italic subset, «guillemets»). Same controls.

The film's narration as numbered Scripture (ScrollingScripture.tsx vertical, Figma 411-2366): heading ("Luke 18:1-8") over a hairline, verses drifting up through a five-line window, the spoken word gold, a dark pool behind. lines = one cue per line `verse|t1,t2,...|text`, each t a word start in seconds from the item start (the cue file's .words.json minus the window start, divided by the film speed). still=true holds the passage and only lights words. dim 0.32 dims the film under it. Put it on the film item, same start and length.
Russian build of scripture-scroll (Cyrillic subset). Same controls; heading "От Луки 18:1-8".

Blurs and darkens the picture under it, easing fromPx -> toPx over rampSec, with a scrim and fine grain (the closing cards). Put it on the look track over the slow film. Owner levels 9:16: verse 8->25 px over 1.6 s, scrim 0.46; PRAY step 25->44 over the step; question+prayer 44->72 over 2.2 s, scrim 0.36; grain 0.5. v3 (2026-10-16): grain is a CSS dot pattern, and a zero fadeOutSec is guarded. v1/v2 failed every render that set fadeOutSec 0 (interpolate needs a strictly increasing range); do not use them.

The closing verse: gold opening quote mark, the verse in light italic (EN Source Serif 4 300, RU Literata italic) revealed letter by letter over revealSec, citation ("ROMANS 12:12 · BSB") in gold tracked caps after it. Language-neutral. Needs the font packs on a fonts track. 9:16: centerY 900, width 820, fontSize 62.

The takeaway: large Literata 500 in gold (#e6a35c) revealed letter by letter, the highlight phrase italic. Needs font packs literata500 + literata500i. 9:16: centerY 900, width 820, fontSize 84, over backdrop-blur ~8 px.

Question and prayer on one left-aligned screen: gold label, question in Literata, short gold rule, second label, prayer in Literata italic. The prayer appears at prayerAtSec; both stay. Needs font packs literata400, literata400i, inter600caps. 9:16: left 130, top 520, width 760, fontSize 56.
